question.problem: A soap dispenser has a volume of $1$ pint. What is this volume in cups?
question.worked_solution:
A table showing the customary units of volume is given below.

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gallon | $\textrm{gal}$ | $1\,\textrm{gal} = 8\,\textrm{pints}$ |
| Pint | $\textrm{pt}$ | $1\,\textrm{pt} = 2\,\textrm{cups}$ |
| Cup | $-$ | $1\,\textrm{cup} = 8\,\textrm{fl oz}$ |
| Fluid ounce | $\textrm{fl oz}$ | $-$ |

So, $1\,\textrm{pint}$ is equivalent to $2\,\textrm{cups}.$
